title: Thánh đường chìm
about: Round x5 of the dark ambient style (khong-gian), as the user asked ("hãy sáng tác thêm cho tôi nhiều bài nữa"): a cathedral sunk under the sea: the organ heard as if through water, low and soft, the choir far away, drops and the bell rising out of the deep. E flat minor at 44 bpm. An original piece.
